title: Oscar and the Wardrobe
author: V. M. Yarrow
blurb: Odile Okonkwo, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
